test_cases.tc_title: USB default Repeat All on playback start
test_cases.pre_conditions:
1. USB device connected and selected.
2. Playlist has >=2 tracks.
test_cases.test_procedure:
1. Start playback from USB.
2. Check the Repeat mode indicator.
test_cases.expected_result:
1. Playback starts.
2. Repeat mode is Repeat All (softkey highlighted, label 'Repeat All').
test_cases.test_item: The HU USB device shall default to Repeat All.

test_cases.tc_title: Repeat All loops to first after last
test_cases.pre_conditions:
1. USB Repeat All active.
2. Positioned on last track.
test_cases.test_procedure:
1. Let the last track finish.
2. Check which track plays next.
test_cases.expected_result: 1. The first track of the playlist starts playing.
test_cases.test_item: Repeat All shall continue from first item after the last.

test_cases.test_procedure:
1. Let the current track finish.
2. Check which track plays next.
test_cases.expected_result: 1. The same track restarts from the beginning.
test_cases.test_item: Repeat Song shall replay the current item from the start.

test_cases.tc_title: Repeat softkey toggles All and Song labels
test_cases.test_procedure:
1. Press the Repeat softkey.
2. Verify the softkey label and highlight.
test_cases.expected_result: 1. Mode changes to Repeat Song; softkey highlighted, label 'Repeat Song'.
test_cases.test_item: Repeat softkey shall toggle between Repeat All and Repeat Song.

test_cases.tc_title: Verify whether Repeat Off state exists
test_cases.test_procedure:
1. Cycle the Repeat softkey through all states.
2. Check whether an Off/No-Repeat state appears.
test_cases.expected_result: 1. Confirm the set of Repeat states matches the agreed spec (2 vs 3 states — needs clarification).
test_cases.test_item: SPEC PC4 lists Repeat Off as a third state (not in requirement).
test_cases.split_reason: SPEC PC4 與 domain pack 衝突(3 態 vs 2 態),需 Gate① 確認
